AFTER_CRASH: No launch permission after restart regardless of prior outcome; preserve spent/unknown claim
CLAIMANT_RULE: Only original live claimant control flow after successful exclusive reservation, both barriers and independent confirmation. No serialized/reusable launch token; no restart recovery launch.
GOVERNANCE: Effective104: designated qualified controller alone exercises grant; OS permissions confer no grant authority; no host-wide exclusivity claim
INDEPENDENT_CONFIRMATION: Confirms record but grants no fresh launch permission to another claimant; independent reader cannot replay claim as authorization
NON_TRANSFERABILITY: Future qualified principal/process-owned call path with no token export/delegation, caller identity and no alternate route within governed grant context; actual technical principal/interface unqualified
REAL_INTERFACE: Disabled until separately issued exact probe grant and all entry qualification
SINGLE_USE: Controller irreversibly marks invocation capability spent before entering exact system-manager call. Exceptions/ambiguous submission never reset. Only one fixed argv entrypoint; no external receipt replay API.
